text: 👋 Welcome to Office Dreams 🏢 You are an indie developer with a laptop and a big dream: grow from a basement desk to a game empire at the top of a neon tower. 🎮 Pick a genre and scale, tap WORK and let your staff help. At 100% the game is released, gets a score from 1 to 10 and sells every day. 👥 Hire 8 roles, open the floors of your tower, solve quests and walk the neon City. 🪙 Airdrop points come from playing: releases, upgrades, quests, goals, daily missions and more. The more you play in a day, the less each extra action gives. ✅ When the launch fund reaches $5,000, verified players share the OFFX airdrop by points. Verification is a one-time contribution: $1 in SOL, a Stars donation or any purchase. Tap the button and start your first game 👇 Points are not money. Crypto is risky: the OFFX price is set by the market.

📞 The office phone is ringing Every 2–3 game days (a game day is 90 seconds) a story event lands on your desk, and you decide how it ends. ⏰ Urgent deadline from the Boss, 🎉 Office party, ☕ Out of coffee, 💌 Fan letter, 🏆 Award nomination… 12 events, each with 2–3 choices. 📧 Careful with the Suspicious email: follow its link and you lose cash. Real rewards never ask for your wallet through a link. 🛡 Same in real life: the only official bot is @officedream1_bot. 👉 Open Quests and make your call.

🪂 Airdrop fund: where we are 📊 As of Oct 18: $17.79 of the $5,000 launch fund (about 0.4%) and 7 verified players. 🎮 You earn airdrop points by playing: releases, upgrades, quests, floors, goals, daily missions, check-ins and more. The server counts them. ✅ Only verified players get a share. Get verified once with any contribution: a $1 deposit in SOL, a donation in Telegram Stars or any shop purchase. It is not refunded and gives no points. 💰 The fund grows from Stars and SOL donations and the $1 deposits. Shop purchases do not count toward it. 🔔 At $5,000 the server freezes everyone's points by itself, and 90,000,000 OFFX are split by points among verified players. Then you claim your share in the game to your Solana wallet (fee: 0.01 SOL). Check your points in Airdrop → Points 👇 Points are not money. Crypto is risky: the OFFX price is set by the market.

🏢 Six floors, 30 stars Your studio starts in the Basement and climbs a neon tower: Accounting, Design, Marketing, Game Dev and finally the CEO Office. ⭐ Every open floor can be renovated up to ★5. Each star gives a bonus: Basement +6% cash per tap, Accounting −4% salaries, Marketing +5% sales. 💰 The cheapest first step: Basement ★1 costs $540 of in-game cash. 👑 Collect all 30 stars to become a Tower legend, with a golden crown over the roof. 👉 Open Empire and give your Basement its first star.

🛠 What's new in Office Dreams 🏙 The City is open: tap "Go to the city" and walk a neon street. Coffee shop, Academy, Contract board, Game store, Mall and Arena, each with people to talk to. Their timers keep running while you are away. ⚔️ Studio Battle in the Arena: 30 seconds of tapping. Your rival is a live player, a recording of a real player or a training bot, and the game always shows which one. 🐈 19 city secrets to find by tapping (the cat, the kiosk, the moon…), plus a shiny find on the sidewalk every 5 minutes. 🎵 10 music tracks, shuffled, with "Next track" in Settings. 📘 A new beginner tutorial in plain words. Skip it or replay it from Help. Open the game and take a walk through the City 👇

🛡 Official bot: @officedream1_bot only 🎮 Office Dreams lives in one bot: @officedream1_bot. The game: t.me/officedream1_bot/play. Any other bot is fake. 🔑 Never share your seed phrase or private key (the secret words or code that open your wallet). The "Suspicious email" quest in the game teaches the same: real rewards never ask for your wallet data through a link. 🪂 The airdrop is claimed only inside the game (Airdrop → Token). When it starts, the bot messages every player and posts in this channel. 👤 In the in-game Top, Telegram names that pretend to be staff (Admin, Support…) are shown as "Player #1234". 💬 News: @officedream. Questions: @vtmjs. Check the bot name before you tap 👇 Points are not money. Crypto is risky: the OFFX price is set by the market.

💡 Catch ideas, squash bugs Your office comes alive while a project is running. 💡 A light bulb pops up over one of your employees and stays for 12 seconds. Tap it for a burst of progress (6% of the project) plus cash. 🐞 After your first release, bugs start crawling across the floor. Squash one within 10 seconds for cash, or it eats 2% of your project. 👀 Tip: both only show up while a project is running, so keep an eye on the office during a build. 👉 Hire your first employee and catch your first idea.
